title: sharded-executor: offload request serialization and reduce global threadpool contention
author: Priya Khatri
commits: add sharded executor abstraction and unit tests
move request serialization to background offload worker
implement per-shard batcher and batching policy by latency/length
introduce lock-free read fast-path for kv cache
add metrics/tracing for executor and batcher
docs: feature flag and rollout notes
description: Motivation: production telemetry and perf testing showed CPU-side contention on the global threadpool and high overhead in the synchronous request serialization path. Small, latency-sensitive requests were seeing p95/p99 blowups during load because a single global work queue and a serialize-on-hottpath design created head-of-line blocking. This PR introduces a sharded executor and offloads request serialization to a bounded background worker to reduce contention and free the hot path.
changes_summary: 1) Sharded executor: new sharded_executor module implements N independent worker shards with per-shard run queues and optional CPU affinity. Shards are configurable via --executor-shards and default to number_of_cores/2. 2) Offload serialization: request->wire serialization (heavy protobuf/serde) is moved to offload_worker which uses lock-free SPSC queues to submit already-parsed work units to shards, removing per-request mutexes on the hot path. 3) Per-shard batcher: batching now happens inside each shard to allow smaller, more predictable batches based on latency budgets and sequence-length histograms. 4) KV cache fast-path: introduced a read-only lock-free fast-path for hot KV lookups using atomic pointers and epoch-based reclamation for writers; writes still synchronize but are uncommon. 5) Observability: added per-shard metrics (queue_length, avg_batch_size, worker_cpu_ms), new tracing spans for offload/serialize steps, and rollout docs. 6) Feature flag & rollout: runtime flag executor.shards and conservative rollout plan in docs. Results: internal perf lab shows median latency unchanged, p95 reduced by ~12%, p99 reduced by ~18% under synthetic mixed workloads, throughput improved ~22% when under sustained high QPS for small requests.
testing_and_ci: Unit tests: added coverage for sharded executor lifecycle and sharded batcher. Integration: end-to-end smoke with local GPU backend. Perf: microbench harness in serving/tests/perf runs nightly; this PR includes benchmark artifacts. CI summary: build: pass, unit-tests: pass, integration-smoke: pass, perf-smoke: pass (perf comparisons run in separate perf job, see ci/perf-runner.yml). One flaky integration run was re-run and resolved.
notes_on_safety_and_rollout: No breaking API changes. Default behavior preserves previous single-shard semantics when executor.shards=1. KV cache writer path unchanged except an additional memory barrier; we included a safety-mode flag kv.locked_write for customers to revert if needed. Rollout plan: stable->canary (5%)->regional (50%)->global with automatic rollback on CPU or latency regressions via the console alerting rules described in docs/ops/executor-rollout.md.
review_comments: Shane O'Connor: Please add a stress test that simulates mixed small/large sequence lengths under spike conditions. Concerned about shard imbalance when single long sequence lands on one shard.
Priya Khatri: Added serving/tests/perf/sharded_executor_bench.cc to exercise imbalanced seq distribution and added skew mitigation policy (round-robin seed) in latest commit.
Liu Chen: KV fast-path looks promising but I want a formal memory-ordering justification and a leak test for epoch reclamation.
Priya Khatri: Pushed a design doc link and added leak detection unit test; explained memory ordering in comments in kv_cache_lockfree.rs. Will follow up with a short RFC.
Marcus Bryant: CI perf numbers look good; please ensure the rollout docs include steps to disable shard pinning on noisy multi-tenant hosts.
Priya Khatri: Updated docs/ops/executor-rollout.md with disabled pinning section and added console alert thresholds.
release_notes: Performance: Introduce sharded executor and offloaded request serialization to reduce CPU contention and p99 latencies for small requests. Add per-shard batching and KV cache read fast-path. Rollout behind executor.shards feature flag.
